text: Final audit after Scala 3 style cleanup: scalafim-bids is wired as an independent JS/JVM crossProject and root aggregate member; shared sources have no imports from dataset/design/image/linalg/surface/atlas; parser/query URI/table/project code paths use BidsError/Either for parse/build/query failures after removing nonlocal returns; JVM participants TSV parsing now uses the safe BidsColumn API. Coverage evidence: shared parser/query tests cover filename round trips, exact/regex/glob filters, requireEntity, raw vs derivative scopes, BIDS URI parse/resolve, table parsing, table context, summaries, and confounds/PCA; JVM tests cover fixture discovery, sidecar inheritance, event TSV reading, confound discovery/selection, and table metadata. Verification on 2026-07-06: sbt bidsJVM/test bidsJS/test passed 34 JVM / 30 JS tests; sbt compileAll testAll exited 0.
